mentions.name: openblaster
mentions.description: Open-source utility for controlling the SoundBlasterX G6 DAC on Mac and Linux without Creative's Windows-only software; the CLI can set the DAC's LED colour and EQ bands, and a Qt6 cross-platform GUI is being added so other people can use it on Macs and Linux machines.
mentions.problem: Creative only provides Windows software to control the SoundBlasterX G6 DAC, leaving Mac and Linux users without a way to adjust its LED colour and EQ bands.
mentions.audience: Mac and Linux users who own a SoundBlasterX G6 DAC, including the author's own personal use
mentions.source_excerpt: I wrote a CLI utility last year to control my SoundBlasterx G6 DAC (can only control LED colour and EQ bands) without needing to use Creative's windows only program (I am mostly a Mac + occasional Linux) user.

evidence.value: I wrote a CLI utility last year to control my SoundBlasterx G6 DAC (can only control LED colour and EQ bands) without needing to use Creative's windows only program (I am mostly a Mac + occasional Linux) user.
